rule.name: Rule Name
rule.customFieldHint: Advanced: reads a lowercase, safe Auth.Attributes key that CPA passes to the Scheduler, not an arbitrary auth-JSON field. Common keys include auth_kind, note, source_backend, path, weight, and websockets; availability depends on credential source and CPA version, and the host removes sensitive keys.
rule.regexHint: Uses Go RE2 and is validated by the server on save. Matching is case-sensitive and substring-based by default; use ^...$ for a full value and (?i) for case-insensitive matching. Lookaround and backreferences are unsupported.
rule.builtinDesc: Built-in rules always run after custom rules, detecting plan_type and tier fields
rule.previewNotice: Counts are regex matches against Management API descriptors, not proof that a credential is currently schedulable. The Web UI shows counts only for filename/id, provider, plan_type, tier, path, and weight. Management fields such as note, priority, and websockets may be Metadata fallbacks and do not prove the Scheduler received the same-named Attribute, so they show as unavailable. Verify the final auth_id with a real request.
rule.previewLoadFailed: Credential match preview failed to load; the cards below will not misreport the failure as zero matches. Error: {{error}}
rule.previewLoadFailedDetail: The auth-file or classification-preview request failed, so matches cannot currently be calculated. Retry after restoring the Management API; this does not mean there are no runtime matches.
rule.previewUnavailableDetail: CPA's auth-file management response does not expose this Scheduler Attribute, so the Web UI cannot calculate a reliable match. This does not prove that runtime matching will fail.

native.noticeBody: A binding restricts an API key authenticated by CPA's top-level api-keys setting to one credential group. It does not create an API key and does not manage plugin-owned downstream keys.
native.catalogNotice: This page lists every current top-level key through CPA's Management-key-protected API. Only redacted previews are rendered; plaintext stays in page memory for exact matching and binding creation and is never written to plugin state.
native.rotateNotice: The plaintext key is submitted once and is never stored. CPA config and binding updates are not atomic: for strict isolation, create a second binding for the new key, add and test the new top-level key, then remove the old key and binding.
native.unbindNotice: Disabling or deleting a binding does not disable or delete the CPA top-level API key. The key remains valid and returns to default/free scheduling; to block access, you must also remove or disable that key in CPA's top-level api-keys setting.
native.pathNotice: Only normal AuthManager/Scheduler paths that forward caller_scope to the Scheduler are supported. CPA Home, Alpha Search, Codex Live/Realtime, direct plugin-executor, and any other special route that bypasses the Scheduler or omits caller_scope are unsupported. Before relying on this restriction, also explicitly set quota-exceeded.antigravity-credits: false in CPA. When enabled, that Antigravity credits fallback bypasses the Scheduler and may select an out-of-group credential.
native.loadFailed: The top-level key list failed to load. This does not mean the host has no keys; restore the Management API and retry.
native.emptyTitle: CPA has no top-level API keys
native.emptyBody: Add keys to CPA's top-level api-keys setting first. After refresh, each key can be assigned directly to a credential group.
native.unboundHint: Currently free to use host credentials
native.orphanHint: This binding's key is no longer in CPA's top-level api-keys. The binding is inactive; keep it for rotation or delete it.
native.disableConfirm: Disable native key binding {{id}}? The CPA top-level API key remains valid and will return to default/free scheduling.
native.deleteConfirm: Delete native key binding {{id}}? The CPA top-level API key will not be deleted; it remains valid and will return to default/free scheduling.
native.idHint: A stable identifier for this binding; it cannot be changed later.
native.name: Display name (optional)
native.plainKeyHint: Enter a key that already exists in CPA's top-level api-keys setting. Plaintext is submitted once and cannot be viewed again.
native.selectedKeyHint: This key comes from CPA's current top-level api-keys. Only a redacted preview is rendered; plaintext is never placed in page elements or written to plugin state.
native.keepKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current key
native.rotateKeyHint: Leave blank to keep the current binding. If entered, synchronize the same new key to CPA's top-level api-keys setting.
native.groupHint: Includes built-in and enabled classification groups; enter another group manually if needed.
native.limitsInvalid: Limits must be zero or positive numbers.
native.limitsHint: Empty or 0 = unlimited. USD usage is priced via the global alias table; models without a priced alias count calls but bill $0.
